instruments.schedule_changes: completion to 2026-09-30; monthly rate: E.54.010; 8 per cent on C.32.030, C.32.010, D.41.020, B.23.010

commencement.quote: The Term as let ran from 5 January 2025 to 27 September 2025.

completion_as_let.quote: The Term as let ran from 5 January 2025 to 27 September 2025.

completion.quote: As twice extended it runs from 5 January 2025 to 30 September 2026.

window_days.quote: An application shall be submitted within 21 days of the end of the period it covers.

retention_pct.evidence: header check: retention reproduced on 900 of 900 applications
retention_pct.quote: The Contractor shall retain 5 per cent of the value of each valuation.

retention_rounding.evidence: header check: retention reproduced on 900 of 900 applications
retention_rounding.quote: and is rounded down to the nearest halala.

rate_rounding.quote: a half halala being rounded upward. Rates shall not be rounded at intermediate steps.

conversion_rounding.quote: rounded to the nearest halala with a half rounded to the nearer even halala

rest_days.quote: The rest days under this Subcontract are Friday and Saturday.

night_hours.quote: Work executed between 18:00 and 06:00 is Night Work

zone_factor_series.quote: The factors below apply to every item in Series A, B, C and D.

concurrent_uplifts.quote: In the absence of such an instruction the rest-day uplift alone applies.

night_uplift_max_zone_factor.quote: The night-working uplift is not payable on an item priced at a zone factor exceeding 1.1

ground_datum_after.quote: for work executed after 27 September 2025, the ground classification is taken as

ground_datum_class.quote: the ground classification is taken asG2 Firm Sabkha

bands_counted_from.quote: The bands are counted from zero at the start of each Contract Year (Clause 3A)

contract_year.quote: The first Contract Year runs from the Commencement Date to the day before its first anniversary.

chargeable_hour_deduction.quote: the quantity measured is one hour fewer.

index_base.evidence: calibration: reproduces the billed rate on 281 of 286 lines
index_base.quote: Site Materials Index, base 100.00 at 5 January 2025

retro_settlement.quote: shall be shown as a single adjustment on the first Application for Payment submitted on or after the date of issue, and on no other.

survey_tolerance_pct.quote: a measured quantity not exceeding the surveyed quantity by more than 2 per cent is payable as measured.

retention_release_share.quote: one half of the retention held on all earlier Applications is released, rounded down to the halala.

week_min_days.quote: a week is measurable only where the record shows work on not fewer than five days of that week.

traffic_management_item.quote: Item E.51.020 is not measurable for a work area on a day on which any of items D.41.020, D.41.030, D.41.050, D.43.010 or D.43.020 is measured for that work area.

surfacing_items.quote: Item E.51.020 is not measurable for a work area on a day on which any of items D.41.020, D.41.030, D.41.050, D.43.010 or D.43.020 is measured for that work area.
